definition: the evening moment when the sun goes down
description: Filmed from inside a car looking out of the open window across an empty marked car park. The sun sits low on the horizon at the end of the tarmac and floods the whole shot with orange light, throwing a long shadow behind a woman walking towards the car. She is barefoot in a white summer dress and carries a flat pizza box in both hands; she comes up to the window smiling, leans in and hands the pizza box through it while the sun goes down behind her.
transcript: I bring your pizza. I am your sunshine today.
